title: Special permit for Monitor Point tower design, Greenpoint
summary: This application seeks a special permit to modify height, setback, tower width and waterfront yard rules for the Monitor Point development in Greenpoint, Brooklyn. It is one of several linked land use actions that together would allow a roughly 939,600-square-foot mixed-use project with about 1,150 residential units, 300 of them income-restricted, plus commercial, community facility and public open space. The Council held a public hearing on May 27, 2026 and the Land Use Committee recommended approval with modifications on June 25, 2026.
